description: Change a map: its name, where it is centred (center_type 1 = an address, 2 = coordinates, 3 = the first record) and its zoom. Pass only what changes. `add_data_sources` adds sources of markers and `remove_data_source_ids` removes sources by the ids list_maps shows (798); every other source stays as it is. Ids come from list_maps.

add_data_sources.description: Sources of markers to ADD to the ones the map has. Each needs address_field_id, or latitude_field_id with longitude_field_id.

address_field_id.description: The field with the address (id or name)

info_window_field_id.description: The field shown in the marker's popup

marker_title_field_id.description: The field shown as the marker's title

report_id.description: Instead of entity_id: a report's id, to show only its records

center_type.description: 1 = an address, 2 = coordinates, 3 = the first record

remove_data_source_ids.description: Ids of the sources to remove, from list_maps

name: update_map
